name: java-seeded
description: A new cancel() method checks ownership with `transfer.sourceAccountId() != requesterAccountId`. Both sides are java.lang.Long (the record component and the parameter, both declared in this file), so this compares references. Outside the Long cache (-128..127) two equal ids are different objects and the check rejects the rightful owner. The enum comparison two lines below uses != correctly, and create() compares the same ids with equals().

expected.why: Boxed Longs are compared by reference, so for any account id above 127 the owner's own cancellation is rejected as access denied.
